author: Yffe
content: Reshape TokKind::Int and Expr::IntLit to struct variants { value: u128, raw: String } per amended .design/syntax/lexer.md REQ-3 + ast.md REQ-6. lex_int captures source[i..last_digit] as verbatim raw alongside the _-stripped value. Thread { value, raw } / { value, .. } through the full IntLit ripple (parser, lower, l1, effects, validator, mutation, strengthen, vacuity, closure, review). INVARIANT: every emit/lowering/mutation path reads value exactly as the old u128; lower.rs/l1.rs emit value.to_string() so tests/golden/* stay byte-identical (no golden churn). raw is AST-fidelity only; mutated literals set raw=value.to_string(). New round-trip tests assert BOTH fields. Manifest-bounded; critic re-audits.
